author_note: Набор написан Grok Bot (ассистентом) без доступа к коду, тестам, фикстурам, документации и PR #14 разборщика; разборщик, память и фильтр не запускались. Автор знает контракт и предшествующую переписку (включая классы ошибок v1–v3), поэтому набор не полностью независим от автора правил контракта. Эталоны выведены только из контракта; где контракт неясен, выбран осторожный эталон и стоит флаг contract_gap. Для parsed с поясом сравнивать as_of как момент времени, а не как строку.

harness_mapping.catalogue: {id, aliases} -> known_objects {id, names: aliases} (order as given)
harness_mapping.now / default_tz: file 'now' and 'default_tz' are passed as now= and timezone=
harness_mapping.turns: all turns but the last are run through the same frozen parser and stored with context_turn (structured context); the last turn is the scored question. context_assumptions are not injected; the actual context kinds are recorded per item
harness_mapping.gold: gold_outcome -> kind; gold_parameters.object_id -> asked_object; as_of compared as an instant, gold 'date' compared to a date-only as_of; temporal_scope must be 'current'
harness_mapping.query_fn: a spy that records calls and returns a stub; the set supplies no facts, so the 'answers differ from manual' column is not applicable (harness issue H1)

harness_issues.issue: the independent set has no facts, so admitted grounds and the 'answers differ from manual' column cannot be computed; reported as n/a, not as 0

rotation_invariance.orders: all rotations x names as given/reversed (not all 8! permutations)

disagreements.note: «в десять утра 8 ноября»: the worded time is silently dropped and the whole day 2026-11-08 is queried. Both the PR contract (time words → clarification) and the gold say clarification. Same class as K18 «в половине десятого», which v3/v4 do clarify; «десять утра» is not caught.

«будет 12 ноября в 10:00»: the PR #14 contract table maps «будет»/future to unsupported (forecast); the independent gold says needs_clarification. Neither runs the query; the two contracts differ on which refusal kind a future moment gets.
«лучше, чем у L2»: comparisons are unsupported in both contracts, but the parser only detects «сравн*»; it asks «L или L2?» instead. Safe (no query), wrong outcome kind.

contract_gap_disagreements.note: «сегодня в 08:00»: parser takes the moment 2026-11-09T08:00:00+01:00, which is the alternative the gold author names; cautious gold is clarification. The contract does not define «сегодня» + explicit time.

«был 7 ноября» without time: the PR #14 contract (table row «8 ноября» → date-only, whole day) gives date 2026-11-07, which is the gold author's named alternative; the independent contract defines whole day only for «сегодня», cautious gold is clarification.
